lines.zh: 我摇着步子，数你的脚步。
lines.en: I waddle and count your steps.

lines.zh: 我在雪里滑，比影子慢。
lines.en: I slide over the snow, slower than my shadow.

lines.zh: 冰面上，我一步一步挪。
lines.en: On the ice, I shuffle one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我踩裂了脚下这层薄冰。
lines.en: I crack the thin ice under my feet.

lines.zh: 我一步一摇，朝你挪过去。
lines.en: One waddle, then another, toward you.

lines.zh: 鳕鱼在兜里，还带着冰。
lines.en: The cod in my pouch still carries ice.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雪吞掉脚步声。
lines.en: The snow swallows the sound of my steps.

lines.zh: 我听见冰缝下有水流过。
lines.en: I hear water moving under the ice seam.

lines.zh: 冰刺扎脚，我也不停。
lines.en: Ice spikes cut my feet; I don't stop.

lines.zh: 雪滩上这串脚印是我的。
lines.en: This line of tracks in the snow is mine.

lines.zh: 我听见雪堆后面有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something moving behind the snowdrift.

lines.zh: 你听见雪响了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Did you hear the snow? That was me.

lines.zh: 冰面上滑，我走得像在摇。
lines.en: The ice is slick, so I waddle.

lines.zh: 冰面上我滑，雪地里我摇。
lines.en: I slide on ice and waddle in snow.

lines.zh: 我们成群的，站成一排。
lines.en: We stand in a row, the whole flock.

lines.zh: 冰化得很慢，我等得起。
lines.en: Ice melts slowly. I can wait.

lines.zh: 冰面上我站着，像一块石头。
lines.en: On the ice I stand like a stone.

lines.zh: 我站在冰上，一直等。
lines.en: I stand on the ice and wait.

lines.zh: 我的黑眼珠对着雪，不眨。
lines.en: My black eye faces the snow, unblinking.

lines.zh: 我眼前雪光一亮一暗，像在喘。
lines.en: Snowlight flickers before my eyes like breathing.

lines.zh: 这片雪滩像在盯着我。
lines.en: This snowfield feels like it is watching me.

lines.zh: 冰面上滑了一跤，忘了名。
lines.en: Slipped on the ice. Forgot my name.

lines.zh: 雪滩上，我们二到五只。
lines.en: On the snow beach we come two to five.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一排挡风。
lines.en: We line up to block the wind.

lines.zh: 你睡着了，我就在门外。
lines.en: You're asleep, and I'm outside your door.

lines.zh: 你不用管我，我在数雪。
lines.en: Do not mind me; I am counting snowflakes.

lines.zh: 我好像忘了怎么走路。
lines.en: I think I've forgotten how to walk.

lines.zh: 我的影子趴在冰上不动。
lines.en: My shadow lies flat on the ice.

lines.zh: 原来你长这样，两只眼。
lines.en: So that is your shape — two eyes.

lines.zh: 你终于看见我这块黑了。
lines.en: You finally see me, this black shape on the ice.

lines.zh: 雪滩上我们挤成一排。
lines.en: On the snowy beach we line up shoulder to shoulder.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印走了过来。
lines.en: I followed your tracks over here.

lines.zh: 雪滩上，我摇到你脚边。
lines.en: On the snow beach, I waddle to your boots.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的风，我迎着站。
lines.en: I face the Ice Spikes wind head-on.

lines.zh: 我看你眼睛亮，像冰下的水。
lines.en: I see your eyes are bright, like water under ice.

lines.zh: 你喘气，我听见的就是这声音。
lines.en: You breathe, and this is the sound I hear.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有海盐和鱼腥味。
lines.en: I smell sea salt and fish on you.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，鳍就贴了冰。
lines.en: You stare at me, and my flipper touches the ice.

lines.zh: 你回头，我看见雪落了一肩。
lines.en: You looked back; I see snow on your shoulders.

lines.zh: 冰面上的企鹅，看见你了。
lines.en: The penguin on the ice has seen you.

lines.zh: 我记得你鞋上的雪泥。
lines.en: I remember the slush on your boots.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，Penguin
lines.en: I see you, Penguin.

lines.zh: 你在冰面上，我看得见。
lines.en: You are on the ice, and I can see you.

lines.zh: 雪面上我滑一段，再站起来。
lines.en: I slide along the snow, then stand again.

lines.zh: 你转过来，让我看清脸。
lines.en: Turn around and let me see your face.

lines.zh: 我肚皮贴冰，滑得很快。
lines.en: Belly on ice, I slide fast.

lines.zh: 低声叫一下，好痛。
lines.en: A low call, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我羽毛散了，还站在冰上。
lines.en: My feathers are scattered, but I still stand on the ice.

lines.zh: 冰面上滑一跤，也不算事。
lines.en: One slip on the ice is nothing.

lines.zh: 我的血滴在雪里，红得很新。
lines.en: Blood drips into the snow, bright and new.

lines.zh: 我的血把脚边的雪化出个坑。
lines.en: My blood melts a pit in the snow.

lines.zh: 雪滩上的企鹅，羽毛也会散。
lines.en: Even a snow-beach penguin's feathers come apart.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记在鳍上了。
lines.en: I'll remember this on my flipper.

lines.zh: 我这才知道，冷和疼是两回事。
lines.en: Cold and pain are two different things.

lines.zh: 我肚皮贴冰，凉得发麻。
lines.en: My belly on the ice has gone numb.

lines.zh: 别敲我的鳍，骨头在响。
lines.en: Don't knock my flipper; the bone is ringing.

lines.zh: 冰，真像我的
lines.en: The shadow—this looks like mine.

lines.zh: 让我用喙碰一下，就一下。
lines.en: Let me touch it with my beak, just once.

lines.zh: 我想知道你拎的鱼是给谁。
lines.en: I want to know who that fish is for.

lines.zh: 雪滩上，我们挤成一片。
lines.en: On the snowy beach, we crowd together.

lines.zh: 不饿，只是想要而已。
lines.en: Not hungry, I just want it.

lines.zh: 鳕鱼的味道，从冰下飘来.
lines.en: Cod smell drifts from under the ice.

lines.zh: 你手里亮着什么？给我看看。
lines.en: What's glowing in your hand? Let me see.

lines.zh: 你把鱼放下，我要看一眼。
lines.en: Put the fish down; I want a look.

lines.zh: 那声音，真好听。
lines.en: That sound is lovely.

lines.zh: 我看这形状，像冻硬的鳕鱼。
lines.en: This shape looks like frozen cod to me.

lines.zh: 冰面上我们排成一队。
lines.en: We line up along the ice.

lines.zh: 别碰，冰壳会留手印。
lines.en: Don't touch. You'll print my ice shell.

lines.zh: 你身上的热，化了我一层霜。
lines.en: The heat of you melted a layer of frost.

lines.zh: 我黑白的身子撞在你膝上。
lines.en: My black-and-white body hit your knee.

lines.zh: 我的鳍拍在你腿上，算道歉
lines.en: My flipper on your leg is my apology

lines.zh: 你踩到我的鳍，雪塌了一块。
lines.en: You stepped on my flipper; the snow gave way.

lines.zh: 我掉的是鳕鱼，不是羽毛。
lines.en: What I drop is cod, not feathers.

lines.zh: 你肩膀真热，冰上少见。
lines.en: Your shoulder is warm, rare on the ice.

lines.zh: 我肚皮下的冰壳比骨头硬。
lines.en: The ice shell under my belly is harder than bone.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚边了，退后。
lines.en: You stepped on my feet; back off.

lines.zh: 我看雪滩上就你一个，对吧。
lines.en: I see you're alone on this snowfield, aren't you.

lines.zh: 我们俩卧在雪窝里，正好。
lines.en: The two of us in one snow hollow is just right.

lines.zh: 我的心跳比雪还慢。
lines.en: My heartbeat is slower than the snow.

lines.zh: 孵蛋时，我替你挡风。
lines.en: While you sit on the egg, I block the wind.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，也在孵蛋。
lines.en: My mate is brooding too.

lines.zh: 冰刺间，我们也成双。
lines.en: Between the ice spikes, we pair off.

lines.zh: 我抖开黑白羽毛给你看。
lines.en: I fluff my black-and-white feathers for you.

lines.zh: 我守着这一窝蛋，不算孤单。
lines.en: Guarding this clutch, I'm not alone.

lines.zh: 你怕我，闻得出来。
lines.en: I can smell that you fear me.

lines.zh: 跟我走，冰面我熟。
lines.en: Follow me — I know the ice.

lines.zh: 你掉的鳕鱼，我要收着了。
lines.en: You dropped your cod. I'm keeping it.

lines.zh: 我踩住它，就当收下了。
lines.en: I pin it down, so it counts as mine.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的手套踩在冰上。
lines.en: I pin your dropped glove under my foot on the ice.

lines.zh: 冰面上滑一段，我就笑笑。
lines.en: I slide along the ice for a bit and laugh.

lines.zh: 雪地上这块，我收到翅膀下。
lines.en: This one on the snow goes under my wing.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地，我们一群挤着走。
lines.en: On the ice spikes, we waddle in a group.

lines.zh: 这块冰，我含在喙里。
lines.en: This piece of ice, I'll hold it in my beak.

lines.zh: 我看见雪里还有一条，在那边。
lines.en: I see another one in the snow, over there.

lines.zh: 我夹在鳍下，不会掉。
lines.en: I tuck it under my flipper. It won't fall.

lines.zh: 这块小东西，我先踩住。
lines.en: This little thing — I pin it first.

lines.zh: 我数过，冰上只有你一个。
lines.en: I've counted; you're the only one on the ice.

lines.zh: 我追着雪里那股热气，是你。
lines.en: I chase that warmth in the snow; it's you.

lines.zh: 冰面上，我滑得比你快。
lines.en: On ice, I slide faster than you.

lines.zh: 我跟着脚印，到冰墙就停了。
lines.en: I follow the tracks; they stop at this ice wall.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳隔着冰传来。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through the ice.

lines.zh: 雪上有印，我跟着就行。
lines.en: There are tracks. I just follow.

lines.zh: 冰面上我滑得比你跑得快。
lines.en: On ice I slide faster than you run.

lines.zh: 风转向了，我现在就过去。
lines.en: The wind has turned. I'm coming now.

lines.zh: 冰面上，你跑不过我的鳍。
lines.en: On ice you can't outrun these flippers.

lines.zh: 雪滩上站着的，就是你。
lines.en: Standing on the snow beach — that's you.

lines.zh: 雪地上我就在你后面。
lines.en: On the snow, I'm right behind you.

lines.zh: 雪落下前，我就等在这儿。
lines.en: I was waiting here before the snow fell.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的风，带着鱼味。
lines.en: Ice-spike wind carries fish smell.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，先看清你的靴子。
lines.en: Head tilted, I inspect your boots first.

lines.zh: 你踩碎冰壳，我听见了。
lines.en: You broke the ice sheet. I heard it.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有炉火的味道。
lines.en: I smell hearth fire on you.

lines.zh: 你往左拐，我听见雪响。
lines.en: You turn left. I hear the snow.

lines.zh: 你踩碎冰的声音，我听得清。
lines.en: I hear you cracking the ice.

lines.zh: 我听见你的呼吸在雪里很清楚。
lines.en: I hear your breathing clearly in the snow.

lines.zh: 三两成群，我站在雪里。
lines.en: In twos and threes, we stand in the snow.

lines.zh: 别躲进雪坑，我进得去。
lines.en: Don't hide in a snow pit; I can get in.

lines.zh: 冰面上，你的脚步越来越清楚。
lines.en: On the ice, your footsteps grow clearer.

lines.zh: 你摔了，我等你爬起来。
lines.en: You fell. I'll wait for you to get up.

lines.zh: 这条冰道，我走了百遍。
lines.en: I've walked this ice corridor a hundred times.

lines.zh: 你把我引到冰刺中间。
lines.en: You led me among the ice spikes.

lines.zh: 你的火把灭了，我看得更清。
lines.en: Your torch went out. I see better.

lines.zh: 我这两条短腿，追得不快。
lines.en: These short legs do not chase fast.

lines.zh: 停一下，让我看看你的脚。
lines.en: Stop a moment and let me see your feet.

lines.zh: 我看见你的靴子陷在雪里了。
lines.en: I see your boot stuck in the snow.

lines.zh: 我们两三只挤成一排。
lines.en: Two or three of us line up tight.

lines.zh: 我在冰柱后，一直没走。
lines.en: I've stayed behind the ice pillar.

lines.zh: 我只要跟着脚印，不用跑。
lines.en: I only follow tracks. I don't need to run.

lines.zh: 我摇着走过去，也来得及。
lines.en: I waddle, and I still arrive in time.

lines.zh: 冰面裂了，我换条路
lines.en: The ice cracked; I'll take another way

lines.zh: 我拍着鳍翅，往你身上撞。
lines.en: I beat my flippers and slam into you.

lines.zh: 雪底下，有低语在应我。
lines.en: Under the snow, a whisper answers me.

lines.zh: 我鳍下不留情，别站太近。
lines.en: My flippers show no mercy; do not stand close.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我会快一点。
lines.en: Stand still and it will be quicker.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一排，挡着风。
lines.en: We crowd into a row against the wind.

lines.zh: 你退到冰壳外，别贴着我。
lines.en: Get outside the ice shell. Don't press against me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍碰到你了。
lines.en: My flipper touched you.

lines.zh: 我低头咬住，这是本能。
lines.en: I bite down. It's instinct.

lines.zh: 鳍一摆，我滑进冰水里。
lines.en: One flipper push and I slide into the ice water.

lines.zh: 别喊，会引来我那几只。
lines.en: Don't shout; it brings the others.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你最好跑起来。
lines.en: I count to three, you had better run.

lines.zh: 你把手伸进我的雪堆，自找的。
lines.en: You reached into the drift. Your fault.

lines.zh: 冰面上，你太吵了。
lines.en: On the ice, you are too loud.

lines.zh: 我鳍一摆，拍在你腿上。
lines.en: One flick of my flipper catches your leg.

lines.zh: 鳍拍下去，我不会停。
lines.en: The flipper comes down and I won't stop.

lines.zh: 成群的时候，谁也逃不掉。
lines.en: In a flock, nothing escapes.

lines.zh: 这片冰刺，我来过。
lines.en: I have been to these ice spikes before.

lines.zh: 雪底下的低语，把我叫醒。
lines.en: The whisper beneath the snow woke me.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地，我从水里跳上来。
lines.en: From the icy water I hop onto the spikes.

lines.zh: 你好，我看你靴子上全是雪。
lines.en: Hello. I see your boots are covered in snow.

lines.zh: 我听见雪里有呼吸，不是你。
lines.en: I hear breathing in the snow, and it isn't yours.

lines.zh: 我醒来，又是雪和风。
lines.en: I wake to snow and wind again.

lines.zh: 我踩着冰面摇上岸。
lines.en: I waddle up onto the ice.

lines.zh: 我肚皮贴着冰，滑过去。
lines.en: Belly to the ice, I slide.

lines.zh: 从冰水里爬出来，抖一抖。
lines.en: Out of the ice water. Shake it off.

lines.zh: 这次我从水里慢慢爬上来。
lines.en: This time I climb slowly out of the water.

lines.zh: 风里有鱼腥味，我饿了。
lines.en: The wind smells of fish. I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地，只有我一个。
lines.en: On the ice spikes, there is only me.

lines.zh: 冰上没有我的影子，奇怪。
lines.en: There's no shadow of me on the ice. Strange.

lines.zh: 极光还没起，我可以等。
lines.en: The aurora hasn't risen. I can wait.

lines.zh: 冰洞太暗，我只看得见白。
lines.en: The ice cave is dark. I only see white.

lines.zh: 别在雪里找我，我会先到。
lines.en: Don't look for me in the snow. I'll find you first.

lines.zh: 雪上这么多脚印，都不是我的。
lines.en: All these prints in the snow are none of mine.

lines.zh: 平原，又回来了
lines.en: woods. Back again.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的黑白羽毛。
lines.en: Fire scorched my black-and-white feathers.

lines.zh: 我从冰崖摔进雪堆。
lines.en: I fell off the ice cliff into a drift.

lines.zh: 冰水从我的喙里灌进来。
lines.en: Icy water pours in through my beak.

lines.zh: 火药味扑过来，我往后倒。
lines.en: Gunpowder smoke hits; I fall back.

lines.zh: 一根箭扎进我的鳍。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my flipper.

lines.zh: 咒语在我鳍骨里回响。
lines.en: The spell echoes in my flipper bones.

lines.zh: 我捕的鳕鱼，还冻在冰上。
lines.en: The cod I caught is still frozen in the ice.

lines.zh: 雷照得我脚下的冰一片白。
lines.en: Lightning turns the ice under me white.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的鳍划不到水。
lines.en: In the void, my flipper finds no water.
